notes.title: And we're live!
notes.notes:
Ulama is finally released! Thank you so much to everyone who supported us during development and in the Greenlight process. It has been quite an adventure going from our humble student project to a commercial title, and none of it would have been possible without your help. We hope you'll stick with us during Early Access, giving us feedback, and helping us make Ulama ever better!

Happy brawling, and may Quetzalcoatl back your team!
